local INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS = {
    [1] = { quas = 1, wex = 1, exort = 1 },
    [2] = { quas = 2, wex = 2, exort = 2 },
    [3] = { quas = 3, wex = 3, exort = 3 },
    [4] = { quas = 4, wex = 4, exort = 4 },
    [5] = { quas = 5, wex = 5, exort = 5 },
    [6] = { quas = 7, wex = 7, exort = 7 },
}

local INVOKER_COMBOS = {
    invoker_cold_snap = "quas quas quas",
    invoker_ghost_walk = "quas quas wex",
    invoker_ice_wall = "quas quas exort",
    invoker_emp = "wex wex wex",
    invoker_tornado = "quas wex wex",
    invoker_alacrity = "wex wex exort",
    invoker_sun_strike = "exort exort exort",
    invoker_chaos_meteor = "wex exort exort",
    invoker_forge_spirit = "quas exort exort",
    invoker_deafening_blast = "quas wex exort",
}

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    if (not quas) or (not wex) or (not exort) or (not invoke) then
        print(string.format(
            "[InvokerHandler][EnsureOrbs] missing ability (quas=%s,wex=%s,exort=%s,invoke=%s) dummy=%s lvl=%s",
            tostring(quas), tostring(wex), tostring(exort), tostring(invoke),
            tostring(context.parent and context.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(context.dummy_level)
        ))
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort then
        return false
    end

    if not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(orb, count)
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    QueueOrb(quas, combo.quas or 0)
    QueueOrb(wex, combo.wex or 0)
    QueueOrb(exort, combo.exort or 0)

    if invoke then
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = context.parent:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
            AbilityIndex = invoke:entindex(),
            Queue = true,
        })
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end

    return true
end

return InvokerHandler

local autocast_common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")
local autocast_item_config = require("projectiles.autocast_item_config")

local function GetSafeTeamNumber(unit)
    local team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    if unit and unit.GetTeamNumber then
        team = unit:GetTeamNumber()
    end
    if not team or team < DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS or team > DOTA_TEAM_CUSTOM_8 then
        team = DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
    end
    return team
end

local DummyPool = {}

local function GetRightVector(forward)
    if not forward then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local right = Vector(forward.y, -forward.x, 0)
    if right:Length2D() < 0.01 then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    return right:Normalized()
end

local function GetHullRadiusSafe(unit)
    if unit and unit.GetHullRadius then
        local r = unit:GetHullRadius()
        if r and r > 0 then
            return r
        end
    end
    return 24
end

local function GetFormationOffset(unit)
    local name = unit and unit.GetUnitName and unit:GetUnitName() or nil
    local kv = name and UnitsKV and UnitsKV[name] or nil
    local offset = kv and tonumber(kv.Offset) or 0

    if not offset then
        return 0
    end
    return offset
end

local function SetUnselectable(unit, enable)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if enable then
        if not unit:HasModifier("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable") then
            unit:AddNewModifier(unit, nil, "modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable", {})
        end
    else
        unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_shop1_dummy_unselectable")
    end
end

local function TakeDummyFromPool(name)
    local pool = DummyPool[name]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end
    while #pool > 0 do
        local dummy = table.remove(pool)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ReturnDummyToPool(name, dummy)
    if not name or not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    DummyPool[name] = DummyPool[name] or {}
    table.insert(DummyPool[name], dummy)
end

local function PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
        WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
    if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
        dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    if dummy.Stop then
        dummy:Stop()
    end
    dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    dummy:AddNoDraw()

    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then

    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent() --hero
    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local raw_kv_withlevel = AbilityKV[ability:GetAbilityName()]

        self.lvl          = GetTrailingIndex(ability:GetAbilityName())
        self.custom_level = tonumber(ability.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1

        local raw_kv = raw_kv_withlevel
        local effect_overrides = nil
        if raw_kv_withlevel and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetOverrideValues and ability.raw_name then
            local pid = parent:GetPlayerOwnerID()
            local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name]
            local overrides = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, ability.raw_name, self.custom_level, base_item_kv)
            if overrides then
                effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides
                overrides.__effect_overrides = nil
                raw_kv = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel)
                raw_kv.AbilityValues = NewTable(raw_kv_withlevel.AbilityValues or {})
                for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
                    if raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
                        raw_kv.AbilityValues[key] = tostring(value)
                    else
                        raw_kv[key] = value
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.hero_name       = raw_kv.HeroName
        self.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName

        self:ModifyHero(raw_kv, parent)

        if self.projectile_name == "" then
            return
        end

        local config = autocast_item_config.Read(raw_kv)
        local base_item_kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[ability.raw_name] or nil
        local effects = autocast_item_config.ReadEffects(base_item_kv, self.custom_level, "Effect")
        local additional_effects = autocast_item_config.ReadEffects(base_item_kv, self.custom_level, "AdditionalEffect")
        if effect_overrides then
            if effect_overrides.replace and #effect_overrides.replace > 0 then
                effects = effect_overrides.replace
            end
            if effect_overrides.additional and #effect_overrides.additional > 0 then
                additional_effects = additional_effects or {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(effect_overrides.additional) do
                    table.insert(additional_effects, entry)
                end
            end
        end
        config.effects = effects
        config.additional_effects = additional_effects
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:ModifyHero(raw_kv_withlevel, parent)
    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassive
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveLevel)
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSPLevel, "[HeroPassiveSP]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2 ~= "none" then
        self.hero_passive_sp_2 = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2
        ApplyHeroPassive(parent, self.hero_passive_sp_2, raw_kv_withlevel.HeroPassiveSP2Level, "[HeroPassiveSP2]")
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP ~= "none" then
        self.hero_modifier_sp = raw_kv_withlevel.HeroModifierSP

        if not self.mod then
            self.mod = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, nil, self.hero_modifier_sp, {})
            if self.mod then
                print("[Hero Modifier SP]", self.mod:GetName())
            end
        end
    end

    if raw_kv_withlevel.Skill and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "" and raw_kv_withlevel.Skill ~= "none" then
        self.skill = raw_kv_withlevel.Skill

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent) > 0 then
            self.skill_pure_percent = BpToRatio(tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillPurePercent))
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage then
            self.skill_base_damage = tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillBaseDamage or 0) or 0
        end

        if raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel and tonumber(raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel) > 0 then
            self.skill_level = raw_kv_withlevel.SkillLevel
        end

        self.skill_listener = parent:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_item_cast_listener", {
            ability_name = self.skill,
            dummy_index = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex(),
            level = self.skill_level,
            pure_percent = self.skill_pure_percent,
            skill_base_damage = self.skill_base_damage
        })
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s offset=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(offset)))
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if proxy then
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                proxy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not proxy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end

            proxy:AddNoDraw()

            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)
            local selectable = (proxy.IsUnselectable and not proxy:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][proxy] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(proxy:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            proxy.__shop1_proxy_dummy = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetEntityIndex() or nil
            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end
        if GoodForward then
            self.selection_proxy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        if self.worldPanel then
            self.worldPanel:Delete()
            self.worldPanel = nil
        end
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.selection_proxy)
        end
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        if not self.worldPanel then
            self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)
        end
    end
    return positions[1]

                dummy:StartGesture(gesture)
            end
            if duration and duration > 0 and dummy.FadeGesture then
                Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        dummy:FadeGesture(gesture)
                    end
                    return nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now)
    if not self or not self.projectiles then
        return false
    end
    local my_interval = profile and profile.interval or 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if other ~= profile then
            local other_interval = other.interval or 0
            if other_interval > my_interval then
                local ready = not other.next_cast_time or other.next_cast_time <= now
                if ready then
                    if (not other.is_attack and not other.skill) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif (not other.is_attack and other.skill and not other.skill:IsCooldownReady()) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif other.is_attack or other.behavior == "Target" or other.behavior == "Position" then
                        if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
                            ready = false
                        end
                        if not ready then
                            -- keep ready=false
                        else
                            local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
                            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(other.range)
                            local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
                                self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
                                origin,
                                nil,
                                range,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                false
                            )
                            if #enemies == 0 then
                                ready = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not self or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return
    end
    if not self.special_handler or not self.special_handler.AfterCast then
        return
    end

    local handler = self.special_handler
    self.aftercast_timers = self.aftercast_timers or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        if not self or not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        handler:AfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
        return nil
    end)
    table.insert(self.aftercast_timers, id)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            local range = self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, range, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        clone:PerformAttack(
            enemy,
            true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
            true,           -- bProcessProcs
            true,           -- bSkipCooldown
            false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
            use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
            false,          -- bFakeAttack
            true            -- bNeverMiss
        )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end


        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    if self.parent and self.parent.__autocast_destroying then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

local M = {}

local HANDLER_PATHS = {
    axe = "projectiles.autocast_specials.axe",
    invoker = "projectiles.autocast_specials.invoker",
    phoenix = "projectiles.autocast_specials.phoenix",
}

local handler_cache = {}

function M:GetHandler(key)
    if not key then
        return nil
    end

    if handler_cache[key] then
        return handler_cache[key]
    end

    local path = HANDLER_PATHS[key]
    if not path then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, handler = pcall(require, path)
    if ok and handler then
        handler_cache[key] = handler
        return handler
    end

    return nil
end

local function RemoveApplied(caster, applied)
	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
		return
	end
	if not applied then
		return
	end

	for entindex, _ in pairs(applied) do
		local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entindex)
		if unit and not unit:IsNull() then

		end
	end
end

		return false
	end
	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
		return false

		return false
	end

	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
	if duration <= 0 or radius <= 0 then

	end

	context.special_state.axe = context.special_state.axe or {}
	local state = context.special_state.axe

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

    return FindUnitsInRadius(

    )
end

local ROOTED_MODIFIER = "modifier_rooted"

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.phoenix = context.special_state.phoenix or {}
    return context.special_state.phoenix
end

local function SaveOrigin(state, caster)
    local pos = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    state.icarus_origin = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_fire_spirits" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local fire_spirits = profile.skill
        if not fire_spirits or fire_spirits:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local spirit_count = 0
        if fire_spirits.GetSpecialValueFor then
            spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
        end
        if spirit_count <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
        if not launch then
            return false
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
            if caster:IsNull() then
                return
            end
            local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
            if range <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
            if #enemies == 0 then
                return
            end

            for i = 1, spirit_count do
                local target = enemies[i]
                if not target then
                    target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
                end
                if target and not target:IsNull() then
                    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                        AbilityIndex = launch:entindex(),
                        Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                        Queue = true,
                    })
                end
            end
        end)

        return true
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local ability = profile.skill
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local state = EnsureState(context)
        local token = state.icarus_token
        local origin = state.icarus_origin
        if not origin then
            return false
        end

        local duration = 0
        if ability.GetSpecialValueFor then
            duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("dive_duration") or 0
        end
        if duration <= 0 then
            duration = 2.0
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            local current = context.special_state and context.special_state.phoenix
            if not current or current.icarus_token ~= token then
                return nil
            end

            caster:SetOrigin(origin)
            caster:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

            -- FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, origin, true)
            caster:AddNewModifier(caster, nil, ROOTED_MODIFIER, {})
            return nil
        end)

        return true
    end

    return false
end

function PhoenixHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    state.icarus_token = (state.icarus_token or 0) + 1
    SaveOrigin(state, context.parent)

    if context.parent:HasModifier(ROOTED_MODIFIER) then
        context.parent:RemoveModifierByName(ROOTED_MODIFIER)
    end

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(context.parent, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)

            tostring(context.parent and context.parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then

    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do

        end

    local function QueueOrb(orb, count)
        if not orb or count <= 0 then

        for _ = 1, count do

local INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS = {
    [1] = { quas = 1, wex = 1, exort = 1 },
    [2] = { quas = 2, wex = 2, exort = 2 },
    [3] = { quas = 3, wex = 3, exort = 3 },
    [4] = { quas = 4, wex = 4, exort = 4 },
    [5] = { quas = 5, wex = 5, exort = 5 },
    [6] = { quas = 7, wex = 7, exort = 7 },
}

local INVOKER_COMBOS = {
    invoker_cold_snap = "quas quas quas",
    invoker_ghost_walk = "quas quas wex",
    invoker_ice_wall = "quas quas exort",
    invoker_emp = "wex wex wex",
    invoker_tornado = "quas wex wex",
    invoker_alacrity = "wex wex exort",
    invoker_sun_strike = "exort exort exort",
    invoker_chaos_meteor = "wex exort exort",
    invoker_forge_spirit = "quas exort exort",
    invoker_deafening_blast = "quas wex exort",
}

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function GetInvokerUnits(context)
    local units = {}
    if not context then
        return units
    end
    if context.parent and not context.parent:IsNull() then
        table.insert(units, context.parent)
        local visuals = context.parent.__shop1_visual_dummies
        if visuals then
            for _, v in ipairs(visuals) do
                if v and not v:IsNull() then
                    table.insert(units, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return units
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context, unit)
    if not context then
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    local target = unit or context.parent
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    if (not quas) or (not wex) or (not exort) or (not invoke) then
        print(string.format(
            "[InvokerHandler][EnsureOrbs] missing ability (quas=%s,wex=%s,exort=%s,invoke=%s) dummy=%s lvl=%s",
            tostring(quas), tostring(wex), tostring(exort), tostring(invoke),
            tostring(target and target:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(context.dummy_level)
        ))
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort or not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(unit, orb, count)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    local units = GetInvokerUnits(context)
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = quas, wex, exort, invoke
        if unit ~= context.parent then
            uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context, unit)
        end
        if uq and uw and ue then
            QueueOrb(unit, uq, combo.quas or 0)
            QueueOrb(unit, uw, combo.wex or 0)
            QueueOrb(unit, ue, combo.exort or 0)
        end

        if uinvoke then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = uinvoke:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end

    return true
end

return InvokerHandler

现象定位（不改代码）：
- 复用闪屏：主/SP dummy 已在出池时 `AddNoDraw()`，但视觉分身在 `EnsureVisualDummies` 里创建时没有 NoDraw，直接出现在当前 dummy 位置（往往是上次停留的位置或 10000,10000）。随后再被 `UpdateFormationAtPos` 拉到阵位，因此在镜头里仍会看到“闪过”。闪的是这些新建 visual dummy，而不是主 dummy。
- invoker_chaos_meteor、drow 普攻无动画：动画触发靠 `PlayVisualGesture`，它只对 `parent.__shop1_visual_dummies` 播放。当前场景里 `PlayVisualGesture` 被调用了（攻击/Position 都会走），但取不到目标列表：当 Formation 数量>1 时，visual dummies 是在 `EnsureVisualDummies` 创建后赋给 `self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies`；如果调用时阵型尚未刷新/visual 列表为空或已被 Destroy（比如重建/回收切换的空窗），`GetVisualDummies` 返回 nil，动画就丢了。

建议修改方向（可按需自行实现）：
1) 创建 visual dummy 时先 `AddNoDraw()`，等 `UpdateFormationAtPos` 完成后再延迟 0 帧移除（同主/SP dummy 的处理），避免复用时在屏幕中闪现。
2) 确保在刷新阵型后立即重新写入 `__shop1_visual_dummies`（已有，但要在 RemoveNoDraw 前），并在 `PlayVisualGesture` 前如果列表为空且 `parent.__shop1_visual_dummies` 存在旧引用，尝试刷新一次；或在 `EnsureVisualDummies` 里清理旧引用/保证列表始终可用。
3) 对攻击/Position cast 的 `PlayVisualGesture` 调用，增加一次防御：若当前列表为空但 formation count>1，先调用 `EnsureVisualDummies` 再播手势，保证 visual dummies 都能收到动画。

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)

        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then

    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop1_click_select",
        function(_, keys) self:OnClickSelect(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(4, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit, grant_enhance)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    if grant_enhance == nil then
        grant_enhance = true
    end

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
        if grant_enhance and tonumber(lvl) == 4 and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.StartSelection then
            local item_source = StripTrailingIndex(name)
            Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
                Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(self.pid, {
                    item_source = item_source,
                    force_unlocked = true,
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    dummy = self:ResolveShop1Dummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil
    local bestDist = nil
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                local selectEnt = dummy
                local proxyIndex = dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy
                if proxyIndex then
                    local proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxyIndex)
                    if proxy and not proxy:IsNull() then
                        selectEnt = proxy
                    end
                end
                local dpos = selectEnt:GetAbsOrigin()
                local dist = (dpos - pos):Length2D()
                if dist <= radius and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestEnt = selectEnt
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if bestEnt and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.NewSelection then
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(self.pid, { bestEnt:GetEntityIndex() })
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return unit
    end
    if unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
        local dummy = EntIndexToHScript(unit.__shop1_proxy_dummy)
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            return dummy
        end
    end
    return unit
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDragMotionParams()
    return {
        max_duration = 0.75,
        min_duration = 0.25,
        max_distance = 0,
        snap_distance = 1,
        max_height = 400,
        steps = 30,
    }
end

function Shop1Manager:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end
    return points[slot]
end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDummyUnitName(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    return dummy:GetUnitName()
end

function Shop1Manager:GetRawNameFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local stats = data.Stats
    if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
        local ab = stats:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        local ab = autocast:GetAbility()
        if ab then
            local name = ab:GetAbilityName()
            return StripTrailingIndex(name)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetHeroFromData(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    if data.Autocast and not data.Autocast:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local parent = data.Stats:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            return parent
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:GetDataLevel(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    return (data.Autocast and data.Autocast.custom_level) or (data.Stats and data.Stats.custom_level)
end

function Shop1Manager:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(data)
    if not data then
        return
    end
    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
        if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
            WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end
        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
        end
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    local autocast = data.Autocast
    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 4 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
    local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotMover, slotTarget }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
        local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil
        -- print(string.format("[SYN][Animated] source=Animated pid=%s slotA=%s slotB=%s target=%s lvl=%s entA=%s entB=%s time=%.3f",
        --     tostring(self.pid), tostring(slotA), tostring(slotB), tostring(targetSlot), tostring(level),
        --     tostring(entA), tostring(entB), GameRules:GetGameTime()))
        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(pos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
            main_pos = pos
        end
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:FindNearestGoodSlot(pos, radius)
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local nearestSlot = nil
    local nearestDist = radius or 0

    for slot, pointPos in pairs(points) do
        local dist = (pointPos - pos):Length2D()
        if dist <= nearestDist then
            nearestDist = dist
            nearestSlot = slot
        end
    end

    return nearestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(currentSlot, targetPos, radius)
    if not currentSlot or not targetPos then return nil end

    local dataA = self.Slots[currentSlot]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 then return nil end

    local maxDist = radius or 200
    local bestSlot = nil
    local bestDist = nil

    for slot, dataB in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if slot ~= currentSlot and dataB and dataB ~= -1 then
            local dummy = dataB.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(dataB.Dummy)
            local pos = (dummy and not dummy:IsNull()) and dummy:GetAbsOrigin() or self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
            if pos then
                local dist = (pos - targetPos):Length2D()
                if dist <= maxDist then
                    local ok = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
                    if ok and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestSlot = slot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestSlot
end

        targetPos.y)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 4 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do

                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local dummy_name = self:GetDummyUnitName(data) or "nil"
    local dummy_ent = data and data.Dummy or nil
    local stats = data and data.Stats or nil
